products.title: Tarot Pendant
products.body_html:
Designed and illustrated by Pamela Colman Smith, the Rider-Waite Tarot Deck is one of the most iconic and enduring interpretations of the tarot. Each card carries a distinct energy, offering guidance through symbolism, archetypes, and ancient wisdom — an energy we've magnified with hand-selected, hand-set natural gemstones that echo the cards' meanings.

I: The Magician: A symbol of resourcefulness and the power to inspire action. Connecting the spiritual and physical realms, the Magician manifests what is desired and births them into reality. Set on a slab of lapis, a gemstone of truth and wisdom, this piece is a reminder that you already have everything you need to tap into limitless potential.

II: The High Priestess: The guardian of hidden knowledge. She bridges the conscious and subconscious, set on a slab of white mother of pearl to call in insight and divine knowledge. Wear her to strengthen your connection to intuition, mystery, and inner knowing.

III: The Empress: An invitation to abundance, prosperity and sensuality. She embodies the peace and nurturing of the divine feminine, fostering creativity and wellbeing. Set on a slab of malachite, a gemstone of healing and protection, this piece is a safeguarding talisman that eases your path to plenty, while reminding you that you are deserving.

XIII: Death: A highly misunderstood card. Death signals endings and new beginnings, urging you to release what no longer serves you and embrace change. Set on a slab of black onyx, a protective gemstone of strength and renewal, this piece serves as a powerful reminder that every ending is the start of something new.

XV: The Devil: A wake-up call to reflect on limiting beliefs. Evaluate actions that amount to self-sabotage, and release temptations and restrictions. Set on a slab of black mother of pearl, a gemstone of emotional protection and balance, this piece is a reminder to free yourself of self-imposed limits and rewrite your destiny.

XVIII: The Moon: A card of intuition and illusion, The Moon symbolizes the interplay of what is felt and what is real. Reflecting the shifting tides of the subconscious, The Moon is set on a slab of abalone, a gemstone of depth and perception — reminding you to trust your instincts and navigate the unknown with wisdom.

XIX: The Sun: A welcome beacon of positivity and success, The Sun symbolizes a clear and joyful path ahead. The Sun radiates warmth and boundless potential, celebrating the promise of new beginnings set on a slab of turquoise, a gemstone of clarity and fortune.

The Three of Swords: A testament to the scars we cannot see, where grief and hurt wound the heart. The Three of Swords reminds us that pain can bring catharsis…and wisdom. Set on a slab of rainbow moonstone for healing and intuition, the Three of Swords reminds us to learn from every heartbreak, and derive strength from sorrow.
